scope: Target-specific Ordo Tree Editor development adapter contract. It does not define Ordo language semantics and contains only adapter or adapter-regression requirements.

User-supplied Ordo Tree Editor alpha.20.0.187-dev R3 as starting adapter baseline

rules.rule: For editor_dev qualification, compare Editor effective execution traits with the ownership/trust semantics derived from canonical Ordo. A mismatch is ORDO_VALID_ADAPTER_INCOMPATIBLE unless the source itself violates canonical Ordo.
When the Editor package-tool adapter is targeted, tool invocation must use transport forms supported by that adapter. Transport limitations do not become Ordo language semantics.
When Editor replay is explicitly requested, Auto Answers/evidence must use the Editor-supported replay package shape. This constrains the dev test fixture, not the playbook language.
The Editor authoring/import flow is qualified with source-oriented candidate ZIPs; compiled Editor semantic plans are derived adapter artifacts rather than canonical playbook source.
Structurally declared package-tool execution remains deterministic/package-tool regardless of incidental explanatory prose, consistent with canonical execution ownership.
Ordinary free_text/text/string human input does not expose graph-route actions as business answer choices; explicit enum/allowed-value choices remain visible.
When canonical transition provenance is enabled, Editor validates predecessor/entry mode before action execution and blocks invalid entry without state mutation or model/tool execution.
Editor anti-loop protection distinguishes a new analyst correction/retry event from an identical repeated automatic attempt without requiring fake business-state mutation.

Recorded replay ignores narrowly identified runtime-clock noise, preserves semantic business-state comparison, and reads the selected route from the live result contract. MBP alpha.14 positive control replays 57/57.
The release-hardening Editor package is hash-pinned and targeted native regressions plus headless preflight pass on 0.188-dev R3.
